serp_review.query: why is gmail storage still full after emptying trash
serp_review.observation: A standard web search returned third-party pages (getmailbird, picbackman x3, clean.email, dev.to x2, workalizer) and a forum thread. Common points: Spam counts, shared quota, Drive/Photos trash, update lag. At least one gives an unsourced 'up to seven days'. None in the result summaries mention family-plan shared quota or the two different update timings on Google's own pages, and none give a symptom-to-check table.
serp_review.limitation: One standard US web search summary; result pages were not opened individually. Not a Google ranking capture.

information_gain: A post-emptying diagnostic table and ordered checklist: wrong account, Spam not cleared by Empty Trash now, separate Drive and Photos trash, backups/hidden app data, Google One family-plan shared quota (sourced to 9004015), and update timing. It also reconciles Google's two published timings (30-minute recheck vs 48–72 hours) on drive/answer/6374270. Existing published pages and the sibling draft cover Trash itself and the 48–72 hour figure, but not family-shared quota, Drive/Photos trash as separate trash, or the 30-minute vs 48–72 hour discrepancy.
overlap_check: Sibling draft gmail-storage-not-updating-after-deleting (unpublished) stops at the decision to empty Trash and covers IMAP All Mail; this draft starts after Trash is emptied and does not repeat the IMAP route. Hub gmail-mailbox-full-cant-receive-emails covers delivery and a short breakdown table; how-to-free-up-gmail-storage and gmail-delete-emails-by-size cover reduction recipes and are linked rather than repeated. Residual overlap: both storage drafts mention Spam, wrong account and 48–72 hours. A reviewer should decide whether both should publish or whether one should absorb the other. The draft does not link the unpublished sibling.
limitations: Source and documentation review only. No live Gmail, Drive, Photos, family-plan or storage-page test was run, and no screenshots exist.
Photos trash counting toward storage relies on drive/answer/6374270, not the Photos help page; the fetched Photos page was the Android variant.
Google's timings (30 minutes, 48–72 hours) are stated as normal, not guaranteed; no countdown is given.
Workspace (work/school) pooled or admin-set quotas are out of scope and only mentioned as a referral to the administrator.
The 'Empty Trash now clears Trash only, not Spam' statement is inferred from Gmail's separate Trash and Spam controls, not quoted from one sentence.
